spacing.snappingRule: Each observed padding, margin and gap length is snapped to the nearest multiple of the base unit; exact .5 ties round up. A non-zero length shorter than half the base unit snaps up to one base unit rather than collapsing to 0, because a visible gap must stay visible. Steps are named by their multiplier, so step "3" is 3 x the base unit.
spacing.layoutRule: Steps up to the largest observed length are component steps: a capture is one component, so that is as far as the evidence reaches. The same multiplier series is then continued past it into layout steps at 32px, 40px, 48px, 64px, which are extrapolated rather than observed. Use component steps for padding and gaps inside a control, and layout steps for page gutters, section rhythm and the space between cards.

diagnostics.message: No captured colour in this set reads as a red, so this kit has no destructive colour -- and a brand decision is the one thing the engine will not default. The consequence is concrete: a form built against this kit cannot signal errors in colour. Either set an error colour on `color.roles.destructive`, or acknowledge that the kit ships without one so `design.md` can prescribe the non-colour error language instead of only stating the prohibition.
color.roles.disabledForeground vs color.roles.disabledSurface: raised contrast from 2.53:1 to 3.07:1 by moving OKLCH lightness +0.045 (#5c6169 -> #696e76).

color.roles.primaryActive vs color.roles.primaryForeground: foreground was already at the gamut boundary, so the background moved instead: 3.38:1 to 4.51:1 by OKLCH lightness -0.07; the offset that bought was invisible, so chroma moved at fixed lightness to restore the state (4.69:1) (#7483ed -> #5a5eff).

color.roles.primaryHover vs color.roles.primaryForeground: foreground was already at the gamut boundary, so the background moved instead: 3.99:1 to 4.51:1 by OKLCH lightness -0.03; the offset that bought was invisible, so chroma moved at fixed lightness to restore the state (4.59:1) (#6976e0 -> #5d66ec).
1 captured colour(s) did not map to a role and are excluded from the kit: #1c1d1f.
Nothing in the captures or the rest of the kit described these controls: badge. Each carries a sanctioned default rather than being omitted, and every defaulted value says so in its provenance.

4 observed length(s) were not multiples of 4px and were snapped. Largest moves: 6px -> 8px (linear-btn-ghost), 6px -> 8px (linear-btn-ghost), 10px -> 12px (linear-input-search), 10px -> 12px (linear-input-search).
